This is a limited-data assessment. Zurich publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset, and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and is labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.
Real official data point: Gewerbeschule sits in Kreis 5, one of Zurich's 12 police districts. Kantonspolizei Zürich recorded an average burglary rate of 12.57 per 1,000 residents there across 3 years (2025, 2024, 2023), 123% of the 12-district average of 10.23/1,000. This figure is real, current, and official — but it covers burglaries only (not the full range of crime types) and is reported at the district level, not for Gewerbeschule specifically, so treat it as directional context for the wider area rather than a rating of this exact neighbourhood.

Frequently asked questions

Is Gewerbeschule safe?

Wandroz currently rates Gewerbeschule in Zurich as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Zurich at night. This is a limited-data assessment: Zurich publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.

Is Gewerbeschule safe at night?

At night, Gewerbeschule is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Zurich. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Gewerbeschule a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Gewerbeschule's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
